name: Image Loader
title: Image Loader
description: A centered image sequence with smooth crossfades and a final image that expands to fill the frame.
summary: Preload a sequence of images, cycle them in a compact centered frame, hold the last thumbnail, then expand a separate final image into the full canvas. Customize timing, thumbnail proportions, corner radius, easing, background, and image positioning. Pause, resume, and replay the sequence.
highlights: Centered thumbnail cycling with a configurable final hold
A separate final image expands smoothly to the full canvas
Waits for image assets and skips failed thumbnails
Pause and resume through the paused prop, and replay through replayKey
Responsive sizing, scoped animation cleanup, and reduced-motion support
anatomy: Final image frame that expands from thumbnail size
Optional content overlay revealed after expansion

physics.description: A scoped timeline coordinates opacity crossfades and the final centered frame expansion. The frame changes its width and height, following the existing Project Reveal pattern, to maintain natural image cropping as its aspect ratio changes. Resize observation recalculates thumbnail bounds without restarting playback.

accessibility.aria: Loading thumbnails are decorative. The final image uses its alt text. Optional content remains inert until completion, and a polite status announces readiness.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Waits for assets and reveals the final image immediately, skipping thumbnail cycling and expansion.

recommended: Portfolio and editorial landing page reveals
bestPractices: Provide useful alt text for the final image.
Use objectPosition to preserve the subject when the image is cropped.
Use onImageError to report failed URLs and replayKey for another loading cycle.
Keep the sequence short and provide a visible pause control for longer playback.

props.name: images
props.description: Loading images in playback order. Each entry has src, optional alt and objectPosition.

props.name: finalImage
props.description: The separate image that expands to fill the frame.

props.name: imageDuration
props.description: Hold between thumbnail crossfades in seconds.

props.name: transitionDuration
props.description: Thumbnail crossfade duration in seconds.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Additional hold on the last thumbnail before the final image appears.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Duration of the final image expansion in seconds.

props.name: initialDelay
props.description: Delay before the first thumbnail appears.

props.name: thumbnailWidth
props.description: Thumbnail width in pixels, constrained to fit the container.

props.name: thumbnailAspectRatio
props.description: Thumbnail width divided by height.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Thumbnail corner radius in pixels. Settles to zero during expansion.

props.name: entranceScale
props.description: Initial scale of the first thumbnail.

props.name: ease
props.description: Expansion easing: power3.inOut, expo.inOut or sine.inOut.

props.name: background
props.description: CSS background color behind the thumbnails.

props.name: paused
props.description: Pause or resume the current timeline without restarting.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change this value to replay from the beginning.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible loading status.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional content that fades in over the final image.

props.name: className
props.description: Container size and styling classes.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when the reveal completes.

props.name: onImageError
props.description: Reports failed assets. Failed thumbnails are skipped and a final-image error is shown after revealing.
